biothings.name: skin sarcoidosis
biothings.definition: Formation of non-necrotizing granulomas in the skin. It may be a manifestation of systemic sarcoidosis or may also arise in isolation. [NCIT:P378]
biothings.synonyms: cutaneous sarcoidosis, sarcoidosis of zone of skin, zone of skin sarcoidosis

biothings.name: cerebral sarcoidosis
biothings.synonyms: cerebral sarcoidosis, sarcoidosis of telencephalon, telencephalon sarcoidosis

biothings.name: cardiac sarcoidosis
biothings.definition: Sarcoidosis affecting the tissues of the heart. [NCIT:P378]

biothings.name: pulmonary sarcoidosis
biothings.definition: Sarcoidosis affecting the lung parenchyma. It is characterized by the presence of non-necrotizing granulomas in the lung tissues. It is manifested with dyspnea, cough, fever, night sweats, fatigue, and weight loss. [NCIT:P378]

biothings.name: hypercalcemic sarcoidosis
biothings.definition: Sarcoidosis with a complication of hypercalcemia. [PMID:17685088]

opentargets.name: sarcoidosis
opentargets.description: Sarcoidosis is a multisystemic disorder of unknown cause characterized by the formation of immune granulomas in involved organs.

opentargets.name: ocular sarcoidosis
opentargets.description: A leading cause of inflammatory eye disease is sarcoidosis. Ocular sarcoidosis can involve any part of the eye, and may cause uveitis, scleritis, eyelid abnormalities, conjunctival granuloma, optic neuropathy, lacrimal gland enlargement and orbital inflammation.
